The containerd config command has one subcommand, named default, which will display on standard output the default containerd config for this version of the containerd daemon.

This output can be piped to a containerd-config.toml(5) file and placed in /etc/containerd to be used as the configuration for containerd on daemon startup. The configuration can be placed in any filesystem location and used with the --config option to the containerd daemon as well.

See containerd-config.toml(5) for more information on the containerd configuration options.

default
This subcommand will output the TOML formatted containerd configuration to standard output
Please file any specific issues that you encounter at https://github.com/containerd/containerd.
